UI_LCC_GridSort_Tooltip: Auto-sort this container by item name.
UI_LCC_GridSort_MassPlayer_Tooltip: Consolidate duplicate items across your inventory and carried containers, then sort every eligible container by name.
UI_LCC_GridSort_MassExternal_Tooltip: Consolidate duplicate items across reachable external containers, then sort every eligible container by name.
UI_LCC_GridSort_Floor: Auto-sort is disabled on the floor.
UI_LCC_GridSort_Corpse: Corpse auto-sort is disabled in this version.
UI_LCC_GridSort_Nested: Nested bags are temporarily not auto-sorted in multiplayer.
UI_LCC_GridSort_Busy: Wait for the current inventory action to finish.
UI_LCC_GridSort_Locked: This nested container is currently locked.
UI_LCC_GridSort_Nothing: There is nothing to sort in this container.
UI_LCC_GridSort_NoSpace: These items cannot be represented safely in the available grid.
UI_LCC_GridSort_Unavailable: Auto-sort is unavailable for this grid.
UI_LCC_GridPaneUX_NavigationDescription: The mouse wheel always scrolls the inventory pane. Assign separate keys to select the previous or next container.
UI_LCC_GridPaneUX_ScrollSpeed_Tooltip: Controls how far the inventory pane moves per mouse-wheel step. 1 is slowest; 8 is fastest.
UI_LCC_GridPaneUX_PreviousContainer_Tool: Selects the previous container in the window under the mouse pointer. If neither window is under the pointer, the loot window takes priority.
UI_LCC_GridPaneUX_NextContainer_Tooltip: Selects the next container in the window under the mouse pointer. If neither window is under the pointer, the loot window takes priority.
